text: The short term holder cost basis cluster has now turned into resistance. $BTC pushed up into this block today and was rejected. These buyers are back near break-even, where many tend to sell. A close above $65K would show that demand can absorb their selling.

Altcoins led the market after news broke that Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang. Within 20 minutes, almost every top-50 coin was beating $BTC. The market reached for risk quickly: altcoins moved most, follower by the Nasdaq and Bitcoin, then the S&P 500.

$BTC bounced just above the whale cost basis. Whales holding 10k–100k BTC bought here, almost exactly at the realized price. This region is strong support, and Saturday's low turned just above it. As long as price holds over this zone, the average holder stays in profit.

$BTC trades near $63k on Monday after a weekly slide of about 6%. Leverage was flushed and ETF outflows hit the heaviest since July, while short-term holders sit at a deep loss and momentum stays oversold. Read our latest BTC Market Pulse 👇

$BTC ETF volume has dried up. It is now below its median since launch, while outflows run near $260M per day. The last stretch this quiet, in mid-2024, came before the run to $100K. Periods of apathy tend to be better times to accumulate than periods of hype.

Crypto perps now trade billions before companies IPO. $ANT did 9.5B before its IPO and $SPCX 3.9B. OpenAI is already at 6.3B with no listing date set. $ANT and $SPCX traded most on Binance, then Hyperliquid. For OpenAI, Gate leads with 36%, ahead of Binance and Bitget.

The altcoin froth is gone. In late September, total spot volume was 4x Bitcoin's. Today that ratio is below the summer lows. In risk-off markets, capital tends to consolidate into $BTC. In risk-on markets, this capital moves back into riskier assets.

The short-term holder cluster under $BTC has failed to hold. As price broke below the $62K–$65K block, short-term holders started ramping up their selling at a loss. Cost basis clusters like this often become resistance once price is below them.

Whales trading on Hyperliquid are short $BTC. Aside from a brief flip to long last week, they have been net short since the beginning of November. They stayed short into this morning's new low, though the position has shrunk slightly.

The largest $BTC liquidation cluster has been cleared. We have been tracking a dense cluster of long liquidations between $59K and $62K for months. Yesterday, they were fully cleared out, removing a large source of forced selling under price.
